messages:
Nora: Proposal: add a "migration-pin" sprint lane for customers needing a stable model during catalog swaps. TTL 21 days, one extension possible.
Amit: Sounds good. We need gating criteria and capacity guardrails.
Sophie: Canary idea: 24-72h shadow with min 2k samples, metrics: accuracy delta <=0.5%, embed drift <=0.04, p99 latency <=240ms.
Jorge: Ops: reserve a labeled slot for pinned tenants to avoid preemption. Also retention of rollback binaries for TTL+7 days.
Nora: Approval flow: Solutions+Sales signoff, Solutions provides SLOs and qps estimate.
deploy-bot: Draft policy snippet:
```
pin: {ttl_days:21, extensions:1, reserved:true}
canary: {window:"48h", min_samples:2000, metrics:["acc_delta","embed_drift","p99"]}
rollback: {auto_after_hours:3, notify:["ops","product"]}
```
Sophie: Also add an SDK compatibility warning if tokenization changes detected.
Legal: We'll add pilot SOW language around rollback limits and liability.
Nora: Next: I'll write short RFC and list two pilot customers. Owners: Sophie (bench), Jorge (ops), Amit (automation), Legal+Sales for SOW. Target pilot in 5 weeks. :thumbsup:
